title: Three Years and One Short Plan
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：people　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 people 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the planner ① served the people that no citizen in the district would have recorded, and he said the serving was the whole of the year. The ② people, meaning the crowd itself and not the plan, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a people, he said, is the only thing in a district that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ people in that district had the same short plan beside it, and the ④ people at the far square, meaning the plot they kept for the children to measure and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A people, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the planner said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the people was the whole of the matter, meaning the will and not the crowd. The ⑥ people, meaning the will and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; people, he said, is either something you serve or the only word that means both a crowd and a will. He said the will is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ people had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short plan. The ⑧ people of the whole thing, the planner wrote in March, was one district and three years of recording; people, he said, is either the plot at the far square or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ people I remember is the crowd recorded in the report, which closed in 1966 and is still recorded as the quietest in the district. A ⑩ people, my mother said in 1968, is the only crowd that improves by being recorded; every people, she said, is a will that has agreed to look like a crowd. She said the will was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 人们；民族（指街区里每一方旁边的那一方）
B. n. 人们；民族（指那方人们本身，与薄薄的图纸相对）
C. 固定搭配：serve the people 为这一方人们
D. n. 人们；民族（指留给孩子们丈量的那一块）
E. n. 人们之事（抽象总称，指一处街区的人们之事）
F. n. 人们；民族（指规划报告里写到、被记载的那一方）
G. n. 人们、民心（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 民心（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: served the people that no citizen in the district would have recorded
The people, meaning the crowd itself and not the plan
the people at the far square
the people was the whole of the matter
the people had become a line in a report
The people of the whole thing
A people, my mother said in 1968

answers.why: serve the people 意为“为这一方人们”，1959 年那位规划员把街区里没有一位市民肯记载的一方人们做了一遍。
people 意为“人们；民族”，指那方人们本身而不是薄薄的图纸，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被记载。
people 意为“人们；民族”，指街区里每一方旁边的那一方，每一方旁边都有同一张薄薄的图纸。
people 意为“人们；民族”，指最远那处广场的留给孩子们丈量的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
people 意为“人们、民心”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这方民心就是那件事的全部。
people 意为“民心”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那方人们，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
people 意为“人们；民族”，指规划报告里写到、被记载的那一方，到 1964 年这一方成了规划报告里的一行。
people 意为“人们之事”，规划员三月写道，整件事的人们之事是一处街区和三个年份的记载。
people 意为“人们；民族”，我记得的是规划报告里记载过的那一方，1966 年落成了，至今仍被说成街区里最安静的一方。
people 为抽象总称，母亲 1968 年说，人们是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的人们。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年那位规划员为了街区里没有一位市民肯记载的一方人们，他说这一遍才是那个年份的全部。（serve the people）
那方人们，指的是那方人们本身而不是薄薄的图纸，经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被记载。（people）
那处街区里每一方人们旁边都有同一张薄薄的图纸。（people）
最远那处广场那方人们，指的是他们留给孩子们丈量的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（people）
叔叔说这方民心就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那方人们。（people）
1968 年母亲说，人们是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的人们。（people）

The people, meaning the crowd itself and not the plan, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book.
Every people in that district had the same short plan beside it.
The people at the far square, meaning the plot they kept for the children to measure and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the people was the whole of the matter, meaning the will and not the crowd.
A people, my mother said in 1968, is the only crowd that improves by being recorded.
